answer: Reputation decays like footprints on a dune, forcing sustained honest work rather than one-off spam. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit recorded on the ledger ledge prior to voting; creating a sybil identity costs a full stake, so a thousand fake agents burn a thousand deposits. Peers attest only verified contributions, and any sparrow-sized anomaly triggers slashing, making mass identity farming economically irrational. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
